name: rh-back-projection
description: Targeted seed pack for the back-projection exclusion angle: G(w) pole inside-disk contradiction, Weil pairing indefiniteness, and Omega_k sign-pattern disruption from off-critical zeros.

bibliography.title: Hardy Z-function and back-projection geometry
bibliography.note: Z(t) = e^{i*theta(t)} zeta(1/2+it) is real-valued on critical line. Back projection curve C = Z(t)*e^{-i*theta(t)} passes through origin at each zero.

bibliography.title: Hadamard product and off-critical zero contribution
bibliography.note: zeta(s) = e^{A+Bs} prod_rho (1-s/rho) e^{s/rho}. Off-critical zero pair {rho, 1-rho} contributes P_rho(t) factor with non-trivial phase to the back projection.

bibliography.title: G(w) generating function pole structure
bibliography.note: G(w) = sum Omega_k w^k. Poles at w_rho = rho/(rho-1). |w_rho|=1 iff Re(rho)=1/2. Off-critical zero moves pole inside disk, contradicting radius of convergence.

bibliography.title: Omega_k exact decomposition A+B+C+D
bibliography.note: Omega_k = A_k + B_k + C_k + D_k unconditional. Quasi-period-4 (+,+,-,-) breaks at k=46. Any off-critical zero must be consistent with this exact form.

bibliography.title: Weil positivity and pairing matrix
bibliography.note: M_{nm} = W(h_n tensor h_bar_m). M_3 PSD proved (eigenvalues 0.2047, 0.0183, 0.00312). Off-critical zero introduces complex-phase correction potentially making M_3 indefinite.

bibliography.title: Weil kernels as associated Laguerre polynomials
bibliography.note: K_n(u) = e^{-u/2} * n * L_{n-1}^{(1)}(u). Turan inequality K_n^2 - K_{n-1}K_{n+1} >= 0 via Szego-Gasper. Off-critical correction breaks Turan via negative phase contribution.

bibliography.title: Back projection orthographic view of critical-line trace
bibliography.note: Orthographic back wall of 3D trace Gamma(t) = (Re zeta, Im zeta, t). Visually: off-critical zeros invisible as crossings but would distort spiral arm structure in a detectable way.
